title: Recursive expansion of the matrix step function using polynomials of degree eight
summary: We consider the problem of efficiently computing the matrix step function of a large dense symmetric matrix. To this end, we introduce a recursive polynomial expansion method in which a composite polynomial of high degree is built recursively from component polynomials of degree eight. The component polynomial used in each iteration is designed to achieve strong amplification of the spectral gap across the step while favorably positioning the updated gap for subsequent iterations.
